{{Top|leg}}
The '''Colonnades''' were a part of the [[Anaxes Citadel]], and soared over the [[Grand Piazza]]. They led from the Piazza to the corridors and offices of the rest of the Citadel. [[Cadet/Legends|Cadets]] were known to take laps around the Colonnades.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
